title: Best Tour in Spain
text: This tour was worth every penny. Ask for a great guide named, Asier. He was so knowledgeable, patient, and kind. It was the best tour we experienced in Spain. Asier knew so much about The Alhambra, and so much about historical and current cultural significance in Granada, Spain, and the neighboring countries. His insights provided the tour with rich contexts and distinct perspectives. Loved this experience!
author: 761yid

title: Highly recommend private tour
text: We took a private tour of the Alhambra with Asier and it was a very good. Asier was a wonderful guide; very knowledgeable and navigated everything for us which was essential on the day of the National strike. He made sure we stayed dry while it rained and had a comfortable place to wait. And he took great photos of us as well!
author: B2573UVjenniferg

title: Top tour!
text: Excellent tour which we would thoroughly recommend. Asier was very knowledgeable  & gave us a wonderful insight into the history of the Alhambra & it’s many occupants over the years. Well worth the money.
author: NickyS188

title: Fascinating Tour of Alhambra
text:
My son and I just returned from our weeklong trip in Spain and one of our highlights was our amazing tour of the Alhambra with Asier.
Asier was an excellent tour guide who gave us an fascinating look at the Alhambra's history, architectural features, gardens, and palace intrigue. In addition, he answered all our many questions and took National Geographic quality photos of us and the palace.
If you want a fascinating tour of Alhambra with a knowledgeable tour guide who is a top notch photographer and nice guy, look no further. 
Thanks again Asier!
author: C6696APsusang

title: Asier is amazingly...
text: Asier is amazingly knowledgeable about the Alhambra and it’s history. He kept the tour moving with interesting stories and anécdotes.  It was a full 3 hours with a short rest break in the middle.
author: Whitesarahj

title: Amazing tour with Asier.
text: Asier was amazing! We travel a lot and usually get a guide for most excursions. Asier, was one of the best tour guides we have ever had. The Alhambra was spectacular thanks to Asier. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND him.
author: patjonhome

title: Wonderful visit
text: Asier was wonderful. He’s extremely knowledgeable and communicates very well. He taught us a lot about the history of the Alhambra and of Spain (we thought we knew a lot about Spain…). He discussed the architecture and its purpose, the way the gardens and reflecting pools are organized, and lots more. We  considered visiting without a guide, but it would have been a mistake. We would have missed so much about the history and significance of the palace and generally the Muslim period in Spain. Gracias Asier!
author: Daligou

title: Private Tour is Worth It - Asier is the Best!
text: This was an outstanding tour! Asier was an incredibly knowledgeable guide and so pleasant. His tour was wonderful and worth every penny to have our own private guide. Alhambra is special and we loved the tour!
author: Sunshine30233226551

title: Alhambra with a true expert.
text: Just an absolutely incredible private tour through the Alhambra. Great communication with the guide from beginning to end. So knowledgeable about every aspect of the Alhambra. Not just the architecture but the true history about the place and the historic figures who shaped it over the years. I HIGHLY recommend this tour. Would actually do it all over again tomorrow!
author: Alejandro_D

title: Perfect for Young Travelers!
text: I was traveling alone with my 5 year old and am very glad I chose a private tour rather than group. With this age of a child, I would rather have no tour than a group tour. So, I was thankful to find a private one at a fiar price. Our guide, Jaime, did a great job balancing my interest in the history and architecture while also engaging my child in conversation. He was very friendly and patient, and he made it easy to navigate the entrance times and such.
author: Jessica_A
